<b>{{PAGENAME}}</b> is a crafting material that, among other things, can be further refined into [[a carved piece of stone]]. It's also used to craft higher-level stone-work for the [[Graveyard]]. It can either be crafted at the [[stone cutter]] or bought from (and sold to) the vendor [[Cory]].
